value.rationale: The family has one constant combinatorial type and normal fan for every positive parameter yet a sharp metric switch from a unique center to an (n-1)-dimensional center polytope, with explicit thresholds, contact classification and subset inequalities. This distinction between combinatorics and intrinsic Euclidean geometry is the natural motivated value; simply adding a weight to a known inradius formula would not suffice.
